scope.purpose: Score a post-M130 clamped-Catmull-Rom arm without changing the M136 bar after observing its result.

preconditions: M130 crop-early is committed and the exact source commit is named.
A clean private snapshot of that commit is created below experiments\M136-m8o-bar\out; the shared crates tree is never built or modified by this protocol.
The private snapshot contains either the production clamped-catmull implementation or only the recorded M134-equivalent clamp patch plus trace-v3 instrumentation.
The same frozen binary emits the TIFF, M8-R trace, and M8-O trace.
The trace-v3 checker, fixture, dispatcher, runner, and source patch are hashed before any target TIFF is read.
An independent verifier, not the instrument author, passes every commissioning control before the target result is read.

population.coordinate: (capture,x,y,channel), where x and y index the compact final TIFF and channel is R, G, or B
population.full_plane_mapping: (X,Y)=(x+crop_x,y+crop_y), using a crop rectangle independently reconstructed from the frozen placements
population.eligibility: at least one frozen placed input frame is geometrically valid at the full-plane output sample centre
population.denominator: all eligible coordinates, including both output rails and source-support intervals wholly outside [0,1]
population.hard_gate: the independently reconstructed crop rectangle must match the recorded producer rectangle and TIFF dimensions, and every TIFF coordinate must be eligible; otherwise UNMEASURED

interval_definition.per_frame_source: I_k=[lo_k-tau_R,k,hi_k+tau_R,k], with exact discrete support and tau_R defined by M8-R
interval_definition.ordering_rule: apply the exact per-frame map before reducing across frames; old aggregate o-lo/o-hi/o-tau arrays or an empirical global allowance are not substitutes
interval_definition.arithmetic_rule: replay the candidate's recorded scalar types, operation order, rounding rule, and clamp semantics with outward interval rounding; any unknown or changed operation makes the result UNMEASURED

comparison.decoded_output: O=e/65535 for the final uint16 code e

decision.m8_o_pass: After successful commissioning, PASS iff every capture has V=0 and aggregate V=0.
decision.m8_o_fail: After successful commissioning, FAIL iff aggregate V>=1.
decision.nonzero_floor: None. No empirical or statistical allowance may be introduced after observing the result.
unmeasured: the post-M130 source commit or candidate binary is not frozen
trace protocol is older than v3 or omits a required field
crop origin or TIFF dimensions do not independently reconcile
any expected frame/site trace is missing or duplicated
the output path differs from the registered transform and the checker has not been prospectively revised and recommissioned
input, map, binary, checker, hook, or output provenance does not reconcile
decision.combined_m8_pass: The candidate clears this M8 experiment only if M8-O V=0, M8-R V=0, and the crop/reference identity arm V=0. A flat-corpus pass does not replace the later score on every scored quality capture.

trace_v3_required_fields: frame path, frame order, and source-file SHA-256
full-plane crop origin x and y
source plane dimensions and source-plane values
actual pre-merge gathered values for M8-R
fixed arithmetic types, operation order, rounding mode, and clamp semantics
required_state_outputs: meta.json with complete expected and consumed frame/site sets
m8-r.json and every M8-R violating coordinate
pre-saturation aggregate lower and upper hull arrays
projected aggregate lower and upper hull arrays
m8-o-m136-violations.npy with capture,x,y,channel,direction,encoded,L,H,q,signed excess and extremising frame identities
provenance.json with commands, environment, versions, source commit, and SHA-256 hashes

green: exact intermediate-u16 round trip at a quantizer boundary
source interval wholly above one with output code 65535
source interval wholly below zero with output code 0
nonzero crop-origin identity mapped to the compact TIFF coordinate
red: source interval wholly above one with output code 65534
source interval wholly below zero with output code 1
one-code plant outside the exact transformed interval at an intermediate-quantizer boundary
nonzero crop-origin decoy that uses compact coordinates as full-plane coordinates
fail_closed: trace v2 without black level reports UNMEASURED
missing or duplicate frame/site trace reports UNMEASURED
producer-supplied hull or contributor mask is ignored
Catmull hard-step is red for M8-R
clamped hard-step, copy, and convex-bilinear controls are green for M8-R
widened-clamp sabotage is red for M8-R
commissioning.target_path_control: Before reading the target verdict, alter a copy of a commissioned-null TIFF at registered high and low plant coordinates; the final checker must report both coordinates and signs.

limitations: the TIFFs predate M130 and are not the requested candidate outputs
trace protocol v2 omits black level and compact Crop origin
consumed per-frame trace blocks were deleted
aggregate o-lo/o-hi/o-tau arrays cannot replay each frame's nonlinear round/clamp
